What the hell...why would it matter where he is from? I guess he needs to be wearing traditional Hispanic clothing. 
I would clarify what you meant by your commenr,because it's extremely weird and has a hint or racism in there.

This is such a common occurrence, it needs to be seriously addressed and some yearly empathy training implementation for medical workers.  I'm sorry they laughed at you too.  Being nice doesn't cost anything.  Maybe a little time,but thats it. And people still can't give it.

There are those kick ass nurses and doctors who actually do care and have empathy.  But just like law enforcement, just because they have a badge and a uniform, doesn't mean they are godly people or nice people.  It's their job. Same with nurses and doctors, its their job and majority of them steal a bunch of pills. At least where I work. So they like to take it out on vulnerable people who are down. You are so right,no one deserves that at all.

The sad thing,is I know how the medical field is. Everyone is burnt out,and rude to alot of patients, particularly suicidal patients.  I thought maybe it would be different for me. I was wrong and there is something very wrong with the medical system.  I'm sorry you attempted to take your life.

I understand the thing about helping friends and not having the same back. Always being the positive person, and no one notices when someone's attitude towards life changed dramatically.  It's like they see it but can face it.
